criteria.name: Technical accounting and IFRS application
criteria.anchor_1: No evidence of applying a standard beyond routine bookkeeping; cannot name the standards governing the entity's material balances.
criteria.anchor_3: Has applied the standards material to this entity (e.g. revenue, leases, impairment) in a prior role and can explain one judgement they made and why.
criteria.anchor_5: Has owned a contested technical judgement end to end - position paper, auditor challenge, resolution - and can walk through the alternative treatment they rejected.

criteria.name: Financial reporting and close ownership
criteria.anchor_1: Has contributed to a close but never owned a timetable or a deliverable date.
criteria.anchor_3: Has owned a monthly or quarterly close of comparable size and complexity, including the reconciliations and the reporting pack.
criteria.anchor_5: Has owned close end to end and materially improved it - days reduced, adjustments cut, or a first-time consolidation delivered - with numbers they can state.

criteria.name: Controls, compliance and audit readiness
criteria.anchor_1: Treats controls as an audit request; no evidence of designing or operating one.
criteria.anchor_3: Has run an audit as the entity-side owner: PBC list, sample support, auditor queries closed within the timetable.
criteria.anchor_5: Has designed or remediated a control that failed, and can describe the failure, the fix, and how they evidenced the fix to the auditor.

criteria.name: Planning, budgeting and forecasting
criteria.anchor_1: Has populated a budget template but not built the model or owned the assumptions.
criteria.anchor_3: Has built and maintained a budget or rolling forecast for the entity, and can explain the two or three assumptions that actually drive it.
criteria.anchor_5: Has run a forecast through a decision that mattered - a cut, a raise, a covenant - and can state where the forecast was wrong and what they changed as a result.

criteria.name: Cash, treasury and working capital
criteria.anchor_1: No ownership of a cash position or a payment cycle.
criteria.anchor_3: Has owned a cash forecast and a payment run, and understands the entity's working-capital cycle.
criteria.anchor_5: Has managed a genuine liquidity constraint - covenant, facility, or collection crisis - and can describe the trade-offs they made.

criteria.name: Systems, data and reporting tooling
criteria.anchor_1: Works only inside a single ERP screen; spreadsheets are manual and unstructured.
criteria.anchor_3: Is fluent in the entity's ERP class and can build the reporting that sits on top of it without help.
criteria.anchor_5: Has led or materially supported an implementation, migration, or reporting rebuild, and can describe what broke and how they handled it.

criteria.name: Team leadership and delegation
criteria.anchor_1: Individual contributor only; no evidence of supervising or reviewing others' work.
criteria.anchor_3: Has supervised a team of comparable size, including review of their work and management of the close timetable across them.
criteria.anchor_5: Has hired, developed, or performance-managed finance staff, and can describe a specific person whose capability they measurably changed.

criteria.name: Stakeholder communication and reporting
criteria.anchor_1: Communicates in ledger terms; cannot explain a number to a non-finance audience.
criteria.anchor_3: Presents regularly to management or the board and can translate a variance into a business cause without prompting.
criteria.anchor_5: Has held a position under real challenge - from a board, an auditor, a lender, or a regulator - and can describe how they evidenced it.

criteria.name: Jurisdictional and regulatory exposure
criteria.anchor_1: No exposure to the entity's tax or regulatory regime.
criteria.anchor_3: Has operated under the entity's regime (e.g. UAE corporate tax, VAT, ZATCA, free-zone rules) and knows the filing calendar that applies.
criteria.anchor_5: Has taken the entity or a comparable one through a first filing, an assessment, or a regime change, and can describe the position taken.
